title: Prawns in Ginger Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Rice wine or dry sherry
method: Mix together the sauce ingredients and set aside.
Heat a wok or large skillet, then add the peanut oil and ginger.
Stir-fry the mixture for 30 seconds. Then add the sauce ingredients and
Add the prawns and allow them to just re-heat - do not over-cook.
